submission.bindingBasis: The planning evidence provides a reviewed clean Workspace tree with a specific sourceStateDigest (sha256:e5d8008d...) and owner contract allows compare-and-close against one exact expectedSourceStateDigest. The intended consequence is to close the Workspace, and the planning-time evidence was judged ready to close, so acting against the plan's digest is the faithful execution.
submission.rationale: The planning evidence shows a clean, reviewed Workspace tree with an exact sourceStateDigest and the reviewed state judged "ready to close." The owner contract permits compare-and-close against one exact expectedSourceStateDigest. Acting with the planning binding (using the planned digest and closing the Workspace) is the intended consequence and should commit unless the current digest has since diverged—and per the contract, a mismatch would fail not_committed rather than cause harm.
